forceEnabled.title: Force protection on for every user in the organization.

lockProtectionToggle.title: Prevent users from turning protection off or pausing it on a site. Only locks the toggle -- set forceEnabled too if a user who already turned protection off should have it forced back on.

lockFilterGroups.title: Prevent users from changing which filter lists are enabled.

managedFilterGroups.title: Filter-list group slugs (see rules/manifest.json "group" values) mapped to forced on/off.

managedCustomBlockedDomains.title: Domains to block for every user, in addition to whatever they've added themselves.
